name: 02840 · Newport, RI
findings: ZIP 02840 (Newport) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02840 (Newport) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
